meta.name: granola
meta.description: This skill should be used when importing, listing, or exporting Granola meeting recordings and transcripts. Queries Granola's local cache and API to list meetings, extract transcripts, and export to Obsidian notes in Fathom-compatible format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Granola 会议记录导入并导出为笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Granola 记录会议并需要整理到 Obsidian
copy.tagline_en: Import and export Granola meeting recordings to notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Granola for meetings and need to organize notes in Obsidian

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询本地 Granola 会议记录，列出会议、查看文字记录，并将会议导出为 Obsidian 笔记。
howto.when: 当你想导入、列出或导出 Granola 会议录音和文字记录时触发。需要 macOS 上已安装并登录 Granola 桌面应用。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Granola 会议
say.note: Claude 会调用 list 命令显示会议列表。

say.text: 导出会议 ID 为 bbeba240 的笔记到 Obsidian
获取会议“产品评审”的文字记录

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query local Granola meeting data, list meetings, view transcripts, and export meetings as Obsidian notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to import, list, or export Granola meeting recordings and transcripts. Requires Granola desktop app installed and authenticated on macOS.

say_en.note: Claude will run the list command to show meetings.

say_en.text: Export meeting with ID bbeba240 to Obsidian
say_en.note: Claude will run the export command to generate an Obsidian note.
Claude will run the transcript command to fetch the transcript.
